description: Get logs from a Docker container. Supports retrieving the last N lines, filtering by keyword, and including timestamps.

container.description: Container name or ID to get logs from.

filter.description: Filter log lines to only include those containing this keyword (case-insensitive).

since.description: Show logs since a timestamp (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00') or relative duration (e.g., '1h', '30m').

tail.description: Number of lines to retrieve from the end of logs. Defaults to 100.

timestamps.description: Include timestamps in log output. Defaults to true.

until.description: Show logs until a timestamp or relative duration.

name: docker_container_logs
